shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log -3 --oneline && git diff --stat && command -v lore-query-trace || true && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'ajv|specs/hal-engine|spec anchor|validated by|tests.list' package-lock.json .lore specs src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | head -240 && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n 'interface Options|instancePath|dataPath' node_modules/ajv -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json'); console.log(p.version,p.types,p.typings)\" && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/ajv/lib/ajv.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true && rg -n 'export.*ErrorObject|interface ErrorObject|type ErrorObject' node_modules/ajv --glob '*.d.ts' | head -20 && sed -n '1,80p' tsconfig.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,55p' && rg -n 'registry.test.ts' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "awk '/### changelog/{flag=1} flag{print}' ../round-brief.md | head -100 && git diff --check && git diff -- . ':"'!src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts'"' && git status --short"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -C 4 'changelog|failure' ../round-brief.md | tail -100 && git show c7fac13"'^:package.json | rg '"'version|ajv' -n | head"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "Compile tool schemas at registration" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count @{upstream}...HEAD'
